title: Independent C8 re-derivation, tier A: assembly of the engine data (archive-free part)
note: Every number here comes from the project's own engine, framework, direct and spec components. No archive number was read or used by this script. The claims under test (C8, B_done, the six inherited records, the closed-form candidate) are compared only afterwards (compare_archive_C8.py, ../RESULTS_C8_archive_comparison.json).
definition: C8 = 8 T4 = B_old + 4W + 2S + 3/4 U + 1/4 J9 + 3/32 L3 - 1/4 M21 + 1/2 M12 - 1/16 N2 + 1/8 Ndelta + 1/32 Kv (eq:C8assembly, derived in framework/derive_C8.py); B_done = B_old + 4W + 2S + 3/32 L3 - 1/4 M21 + 1/2 M12 - 1/16 N2; C8_partial = B_done + 1/8 Ndelta = C8 - (3/4 U + 1/4 J9 + 1/32 Kv)

status.reason: tiers B (U, Kv) and C (J9) of the engine plan were not run

meta.framework: framework/lri_framework.py Framework("C8", dps=50).from_replicates(strict=True, outputs=W,S,L3,M21,M12,N2,Ndelta,B_old8,B_done8 + the 25 old inputs + C3..C7)

tierA_final.note: tier A (engine runs/c8tierA) with the A3_ddE group from the top-up run runs/c8tierA_topup1 (engine merge_runs.py)

sigma_definitions.sigma_cov: linear propagation with the per-job replicate sample covariance / R, plus precision floors (framework sigma_linear)
sigma_definitions.sigma_rep: sd of the R=6 per-replicate assemblies / sqrt(R), plus floors (framework sigma_rep_total)
sigma_definitions.sigma_pool: sector-pooled projection of every job on the output gradient (pooled_errors.py), plus floors in quadrature

B_done8.note: diagonal per-scalar decomposition (within-job correlations dropped); for orientation

C8_partial.note: diagonal per-scalar decomposition (within-job correlations dropped); for orientation

tierA_alone_vs_final.what: final (A3_ddE from the 2N top-up, fresh seeds) minus tier A as collected; the difference comes only from A3_ddE[eps^0 l^0]

tierA_vs_pilot_inputs.what: C8 inputs from production + tier A minus production + the same 26 scalars from the independent pilot runs (all-sector entries; c8val, c8conv, c8kplus1, poles1, kplus1; disjoint seeds); sigma = the 26 scalars of both runs (linear, replicate covariance + floors)

direct.engine_series_note: C8-era engine series: validation run(s) runs/c8tierA_topup1, runs/c8tierA, runs/c8val, runs/c8conv, runs/c8kplus1, completed by conv1, production, poles1, kplus1

independence.code: no archive integration or evaluation code imported, called or copied (engine, framework, direct, spec and assembly are the project's own); no archived raw data (*_negative.json, *_audit.json, *.expr, P6/P8/U/J9/Kv expression files) used as input
independence.this_script: reads only the project's engine runs, framework, spec/out (archive-free part; the archive_derived_targets_sealed entries are never read) and direct table
disclosure: The task brief that started this phase quotes archive numbers (C8, B_done, the closed-form candidate, and the magnitudes J9 ~ -273.72, U ~ -1296.7, Kv ~ -1487, A9_1, D9_lower, A7_d_1, P8). They were visible while this script was written; none of them enters any computation here.

During tier-A development the engine agent compared its PILOT preview (results/preview_C8.json, B_done and U) with the B_done and U quoted in that brief (tests/compare_brief_C8.py, after hashing the preview). The tier-A production spec had already been planned from the archive-free error model, and nothing in the tier-A run or this assembly depends on that comparison.
Phase 3: the note's printed B_old and W were compared (framework/compare_c8_production.py) after framework/out/C8_production.json was hashed.
